Disputed Land Returned to PM Modi's Schoolmate After MLA Meeting

A construction firm linked to BJP MLA Narendra Mehta has surrendered disputed land in Bhayander to an 81-year-old Mira Road resident, identified as Prime Minister Narendra Modi's schoolmate. The resident had met with PM Modi alleging encroachment by the firm. Following the meeting, MLA Mehta stated on Tuesday that his firm is relinquishing possession of the land and surrendering approvals. The firm is reportedly linked to Mehta.
